cohort: All women undergoing re-laparotomy after Caesarean section deliveries at R.G.KAR Medical College and Hospital in Kolkata during December 2022 to May 2024.
finding: The most common reasons for re-laparotomy after Caesarean section were PPH (atonic uterus) in booked cases and rectus sheath hematoma in referred cases, confirming CS itself as a definitive risk factor for such complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean section is identified as a definitive risk factor for complications such as the need for re-laparotomy.
